title: Replication archive for: News-Based Corridor Disruption and Producer-Terminal Price Transmission in Kashmir's Apple Sector: A NASCDI-NARDL Analysis
description:
Code, inputs and results for the revised analysis of producer-to-terminal apple price transmission in Kashmir using a weekly news-based corridor-disruption index (NASCDI) built from GDELT Global Knowledge Graph metadata, and nonlinear ARDL (NARDL) models with finite-sample bounds tests and wild-bootstrap inference.

Contents. src/revision/ and src/revision/audit/: estimation and additional checks. results_revision/: all output files behind the reported tables and figures. analysis/news_nardl_recomputed_2026_07_14/ and data/: weekly NASCDI, model inputs and Agmarknet price series. config/lexicon_news.yaml: the 213-term lexicon. See README.md for a map from each script to the paper tables.

Superseded material. The scripts in src/models/ and the outputs in results/, results_vi/ and data/model/ belong to the earlier version of the paper and are kept for provenance only.

Not included. The article-level scored corpus (about 8.2 GB) and the raw GDELT extract are not part of this snapshot.
